def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    person_patches = image_patch.find("person wearing white coat")
    if not person_patches: return image_patch
    person_patches = [p for p in person_patches if p.verify_property("person", "sitting")]
    if not person_patches: return image_patch
    bench_patches = image_patch.find("bench")
    if not bench_patches: return person_patches[0]
    person_bench_distances = [(p, distance(p, b)) for p in person_patches for b in bench_patches]
    closest_person_to_bench = min(person_bench_distances, key=lambda x: x[1])[0]
    return closest_person_to_bench
